decision_stage: After repaired primary results and source feasibility audit, before any moisture-adjusted effect estimates
purpose: Assess whether the diagnosis contrast persists when conditioning on additional ambient moisture measures
primary_analysis_status: Preserve the existing primary estimand and model results
models: Matched-sample unadjusted model, otherwise identical to the primary three-outcome model
Matched-sample model adding a three-degree-of-freedom natural spline of three-day regional or state dew-point temperature, with outcome-specific moisture terms
Matched-sample model adding a three-degree-of-freedom natural spline of three-day regional or state relative-humidity index, with outcome-specific moisture terms

moisture_measurement.daily_dew_point: Normalized spatial aggregation of the daily grid-cell mean two-metre dew-point temperature
moisture_measurement.daily_RH_index: Clip 100*es(regional_dew_point)/es(regional_temperature) to the interval 0-100, with es(x)=6.112*exp(17.67*x/(x+243.5)); this is an index derived from spatial mean temperatures
moisture_measurement.window: Arithmetic mean of admission day and the preceding two actual calendar days, requiring all three observations
moisture_measurement.Brazil_history: Include existing 2005 weather history before selecting 2006-2020 outcomes
moisture_measurement.Mexico_history: Keep the same first-two-day weather-history limitation as the existing primary calendar

temperature_targets: Retain primary full-period unit-specific exact P95, shared median and fitted temperature-basis definitions, with both outcomes using the same target temperatures
model_controls: Use the same outcome-specific day-of-week, month and 12-df time spline, Brazil population offset, and Mexico no offset; no temperature-by-moisture effect-modification term

inference.unit_covariance: Joint daily-score Bartlett HAC14 without additional quasi-dispersion multiplier
inference.interpretation: Moisture-adjusted relative associations, with the additive exposure model and conditioning assumptions stated

eligibility: Retain the original core minimum of 250 complete paired dates and at least 40 events in each outcome; require complete moisture windows
comparison_integrity: Report each model's fitted-unit pool and the common-successful-unit comparison across all three settings; log all rank, convergence and variance failures without fallback

coverage_sensitivity.rule: Exclude Brazil units with temperature valid population weight below 0.6
coverage_sensitivity.procedure: Use their existing independent unit estimates for a newly calculated country meta-analysis, including new heterogeneity and weights; no unit GLM refit is mathematically needed for this geographic exclusion
coverage_sensitivity.scope: Existing primary HAC14 and moisture-adjusted HAC14 country summaries, with all fitted units retained as comparison

selection_policy: Both moisture metrics and all resulting directions and intervals will be reported; no choice by p-value or effect magnitude
provenance: Source inventory found all 96 Mexico raw months already local; no new raw acquisition required. Temperature and dew-point masks are checked during Mexico extraction; Brazil uses existing normalized aggregates with explicit companion-temperature coverage and sampled mask checks.
runtime: Raw extraction runs locally in a detached single process. Only small aggregated weather files transfer to the server. Effect fitting runs in isolation with native thread limits set before R startup. Existing engine and main fit caches remain unchanged.
